bibl.seg: 143.4 T. Oxford Ashm. Mus. Inv. AN Inscr. 3019 c-e = P. Aegyptus Cent. 13
Giuseppina Azzarello, The Division Tables on the Sayce's School-book 3019.
Edizione di testi nel centenario della rivista Aegyptus (P.Aegyptus Cent.). Tomo I = Aegyptus 100 (2020) pp. 97-135, figg.
bibl.note: Wooden tablets purchased by A.H. Sayce in Luxor in 1908, now deposited at the Asmolean Museum. Great Oasis?, IIIp ex. - Content. - Structure of the Calculations. - Palaeographical Features: Figures, Marking Strokes and Symbols. - Mise en page. - Mistakes and Revision. - The Model. - Ownership and Purpose of the Codex. - Text.
